usefulness.rationale: Judge support findings named unknown claims or statements that are not verbatim excerpts of their named claims, or invalid citation selections. The dossier body is empty; the reader learns only what is in the identity anchors: Fowler's full name and birth details, his Special Envoy service (with exact dates, and correctly framed as ended in January 2025), and his association with the Svalbard Global Seed Vault, the Crop Trust, and the 2024 World Food Prize. That is a minimal but accurate who-he-is sketch, so understanding is low rather than zero. However, there is no substantive account of what he actually did in any role, no detail on his work, and no statements about gaps or limitations, so remaining-questions is 0. Conversation readiness is marginal: a reader would know his titles and tenure but nothing about his positions, accomplishments, or speaking history. The three flagged unjustified conclusions (vault-builder, agronomist-training, play-count-as-influence) are useful warnings, but since the dossier contains no claims at all, none can be assessed against a cited passage; each unmatched conclusion is returned with citationIndex null.
